lines: - Major Neci Rusalka: "The Doktor's dashing patient-zero in the flesh?"
- Major Neci Rusalka: "Shame. But my Scaldra have their orders."
- Major Neci Rusalka: "Pity. We could've been allies, kiddo. My Scaldra. Put that thing down!"
- Major Neci Rusalka: "Have it your way. By this time next year, nothing will remain of you slugs."
- Major Neci Rusalka: "Meet the co-star of your grand finale. An H-04 Efervon Tank. Enjoy."
- Major Neci Rusalka: "Viktor? Drop them in. NOW."
- Major Neci Rusalka: "Viktor. That's no way to treat our little tourist."
- Major Neci Rusalka: "Oh. Not even to me?"
- Major Neci Rusalka: "Oh, but we're old friends."

- Major Neci Rusalka: "Höllvania. The eve of a new millennium brings with it great change. The war criminal Albrecht Entrati, father of the Techrot plague, has at last been captured. His co-conspirators, the terrorist cell known as 'Hex', will soon be brought to justice. Tonight, we will fill the great... Void of suffering. A New Year... A new era! Höllvania will be great once again!"
- Major Neci Rusalka: "So you're the new lapdog, kiddo? Tell me, Toto, what's he done to earn your loyalty?"
- Major Neci Rusalka: "Not the jealous type! But! If I can't have him... you can't either!"
- Major Neci Rusalka: "Who... who are you?"
- The Indifference/Rusalka: If you came here to use Albrecht's Crucibles, the only thing you'll create is a corpse. Yours.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Hmm. Albrecht's Crucibles. Crimes against the laws of nature. Do not think - for a second - that I will let you desecrate my kingdom with your element mixing.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Ah, The Crucibles. One of Albrecht's many sins. Try and finish his work. See what happens to you.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Stop it. That's unnatural.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: What have you done?
- The Indifference/Rusalka: You are really starting to bother me.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: You are playing with things you don't understand.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: You only pollute this kingdom with these -- elements.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: You've made a mess of those elements. A shameful mess.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Enough of this playtime. Get out.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Kiddo, is this where all your secrets are buried? Well, well, you do have a messy mind. My forces will sort it out.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: This isn't your Undercroft anymore, Kiddo. These creatures are no Scaldra, but they'll crush you still.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: The Void longs for stillness, emptiness. But first, things must be made still.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Why are you fighting, Kiddo? This place was your prison. We can dismantle its pieces together.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Sure, kiddo. Fight back, we can do this, spiral after spiral, after spiral.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Sure, waste your time down here in the Undercroft. I'll have my fun up in Duviri.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Valiant. Honorable. And, an utter waste of energy.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: I have all the time in the universe. You know that better than anyone, don't you, kiddo?
- The Indifference/Rusalka: If you're wasting your time here, who's protecting those freaks back in Höllvania?
- The Indifference/Rusalka: This isn't your home anymore. It's time for you to get out.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Have you ever played that game where you see how long you can hold your breath? Let's play it now.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: I thrive on nothingness. You choke on it.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: If you breathe, it's because I let you.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: You can only tread water for so long.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: I am playing the long game.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: The Paradox can't help you forever.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: I can do this forever. I doubt the same is true for you.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Back to Duviri with you, kiddo. Find out what I was up to while you were gone.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Don't think for a second that you are winning.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: The foundation is crumbling. My will floods in. Flail away, the end is inevitable.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Is this where you hide all your secrets, kiddo? Your shame? Let me wash it all away for you.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: All will be still when the flood has passed.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: You only delay the inevitable.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: I do enjoy watching you dance so frantically.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Kiddo, you are trying so hard!
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Look at you, desperately trying to hold back the infinite.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: There's always next time.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: We can do this again, and again, and again.
- The Indifference/Rusalka: Don't get too excited. I'm just getting started.
